name: Tuomas Artman
profile: Finnish engineer who co-founded Linear in 2019 with Karri Saarinen and Jori Lallo and leads its engineering as CTO. He built Linear's local-first sync engine, a big reason the app feels instant, and the company was valued at $2.5B in an Aug 2026 tender. Before Linear he was at Uber, and earlier Groupon.
interesting_fact: He had already been building sync engines for over a decade, at companies like Groupon and Uber, before making one the core of Linear's architecture.
deep_cut_fact: A well-known voice in the 'local-first' software movement: he spoke at Local-First Conf ('Unexpected benefits of going local-first') and argues the startup MVP should be rethought around quality. Linear's founders say the idea came partly from his frustration with issue trackers at Uber.
notes: Comfortable with podcasts (localfirst.fm #15, devtools.fm #61). A good technical guest on sync/infra topics.

name: Cristian Zamfir
current_role: Co-founder, Cyberhaven (data-security / insider-risk company); listed by EPFL DSLab as VP of Reliability & Co-founder
profile: Romanian-born computer scientist (BS Politehnica Bucharest, MSc Glasgow, PhD EPFL) who co-founded Cyberhaven out of George Candea's Dependable Systems Lab at EPFL alongside fellow DSLab alumni (Kuznetsov, Chipounov, Banabic). Cyberhaven traces data lineage to stop data exfiltration and is valued above $1B. He was originally co-founder and COO.
interesting_fact: His PhD built 'execution synthesis', a technique that takes a bug report and automatically synthesizes the thread schedule and inputs that reproduce the bug, without recording the program in production.
deep_cut_fact: Won the 2013 Open Source Software World Challenge Gold Prize for the Cloud9 testing project and a $35,000 Intel Doctoral Student Honor award (2012). His listed hobbies: guitar playing and singing (he posted on SoundCloud), rock climbing and table tennis.

public_contacts.value: cristi@cyberhaven.io (self-published on his EPFL lab page; dates from Cyberhaven's stealth era, may be outdated)

notes: Not on Cyberhaven's current leadership page (CEO is Nishant Doshi), so his present operating role is unclear. Low media profile; best route is Cyberhaven press or his EPFL-listed email.
